cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_qt_imageformats_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()
foreach(plugin qwebp qtga qwbmp qtiff)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_IMAGEFORMATS_PLUGIN_ROOT}/imageformats/lib${plugin}.dylib")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_IMAGEFORMATS_PLUGIN_ROOT to the explicit imageformats plugin root")
  endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6/Qt6Config.cmake")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT to the explicit Qt Base lib/cmake directory")
endif()
if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_WEBP_CMAKE_ROOT}/WebPConfig.cmake")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_WEBP_CMAKE_ROOT to the explicit WebP package directory")
endif()
foreach(component Core CoreTools Gui GuiTools Test)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}/Qt6${component}Config.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing explicit Qt component: ${component}")
  endif()
  set(Qt6${component}_DIR "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}")
endforeach()
find_package(Qt6 6.11.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Test
  PATHS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
set(WebP_DIR "${SH3_WEBP_CMAKE_ROOT}")
find_package(WebP 1.6.0 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED PATHS "${SH3_WEBP_CMAKE_ROOT}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
add_executable(qi_oracle webp_oracle.cpp pattern.hpp)
target_link_libraries(qi_oracle PRIVATE WebP::webp)
add_executable(qi_images images.cpp pattern.hpp)
target_link_libraries(qi_images PRIVATE Qt6::Gui)
foreach(target qi_oracle qi_images)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
endforeach()
set(data_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/own-images")
add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${data_dir}/generated.stamp"
  COMMAND qi_oracle generate "${data_dir}"
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E touch "${data_dir}/generated.stamp"
  DEPENDS qi_oracle VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(own_images ALL DEPENDS "${data_dir}/generated.stamp")
add_dependencies(qi_images own_images)
foreach(case webp scaled tga wbmp tiff invalid)
  add_test(NAME qi_${case} COMMAND qi_images ${case} "${data_dir}")
endforeach()
add_test(NAME qi_writer COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
  "-DCONSUMER=$<TARGET_FILE:qi_images>" "-DORACLE=$<TARGET_FILE:qi_oracle>"
  "-DDATA_DIR=${data_dir}" -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/verify_writer.cmake")
set_tests_properties(qi_webp qi_scaled qi_tga qi_wbmp qi_tiff qi_invalid qi_writer
  PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 20 ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
if(SH3_QT_PROVIDER_SOURCE)
  set(provider_dir "${SH3_QT_PROVIDER_SOURCE}/tests/auto/webp")
  if(NOT EXISTS "${provider_dir}/tst_qwebp.cpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing original WebP test")
  endif()
  set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
  add_executable(provider_qwebp "${provider_dir}/tst_qwebp.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(provider_qwebp PRIVATE Qt6::Test Qt6::Gui)
  target_compile_options(provider_qwebp PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  qt_add_resources(provider_qwebp provider_webp PREFIX "/" BASE "${provider_dir}"
    FILES "${provider_dir}/images/kollada.png" "${provider_dir}/images/kollada.webp"
      "${provider_dir}/images/kollada_animation.webp" "${provider_dir}/images/kollada_lossless.webp"
      "${provider_dir}/images/kollada_noalpha.webp")
  add_test(NAME provider_qwebp COMMAND provider_qwebp)
  set_tests_properties(provider_qwebp PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60
    ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen" WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
endif()
